solution: On \(y=me^{mx}\), \(P=(0,m)\) and the slope is \(\tfrac{dy}{dx}=m^2e^{mx}\big|_{x=0}=m^2\). The tangent makes angle \(\tan^{-1}m^2\) with the x-axis, so with the y-axis it makes the complement \(\tan^{-1}\tfrac{1}{m^2}=\sin^{-1}\tfrac{1}{\sqrt{1+m^4}}\). Matches option C.
Collinearity of \((-5,0),(5p^2,10p),(5q^2,10q)\): the determinant expands to \(50(p-q)(pq-1)=0\). Since \(p\neq q\), \(pq=1\). Matches option C.

The equation rearranges to \(a(b-c)x^2+b(c-a)x+c(a-b)=0\), for which \(x=1\) is always a root (the coefficients sum to 0). Equal roots force both roots to be 1, so the product \(\tfrac{c(a-b)}{a(b-c)}=1\Rightarrow 2ac=b(a+c)\Rightarrow \tfrac1a+\tfrac1c=\tfrac2b\). Matches option D.

solution: On \([\sqrt2,2]\), \(x^2\in[2,4)\): \([x^2]=2\) on \([\sqrt2,\sqrt3)\) and \(3\) on \([\sqrt3,2)\). \(\int=2(\sqrt3-\sqrt2)+3(2-\sqrt3)=6-\sqrt3-2\sqrt2\). Matches option A.
